_comment: The pause screen's slider labels written as data (T-426). hud_size_label is the HUD size slider's label, shown at the left of the slider like 'Camera zoom level' and 'Music volume'. The slider's value reads as a bare number at the right end like the other sliders, so there is no hud_size_value key. The older labels are still constants in scripts/ui/pause_screen.gd. T-452 adds the HUD layout editor's four texts: hud_layout_button (pause screen button that opens the editor), hud_layout_hint (one-line hint while editing), hud_layout_reset (resets to the default layout), hud_layout_done (finishes editing, back to the pause screen).
hud_layout_hint: Drag a piece to move it.
